```{r setup, include = FALSE}
## Setting up document
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE,
                      warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Loading packages
library(pacman)
p_load(qualtRics, janitor, stargazer, pander, printy, emmeans, plotrix, 
       effectsize, effsize, tidyverse)
```

```{r}
## Setting options for viewing summary tables
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Reading in raw data
e2 <- read_survey("E2_Data.csv")
```

```{r}
## Cleaning
e2_clean <- e2 %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(finished == 1,
         is.na(age) == FALSE,
         is.na(political_leanings) == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(id = row_number(),
         policy = if_else(condition == "punishment", "punishment", "reward"),
         pun_rew_con = case_when(policy == "punishment" ~ -1, policy == "reward" ~ 1),
         prev_fix_con = case_when(frame == "prevent" ~ -1, frame == "fix" ~ 1),
         pref_pay = rowSums(across(c(pay_17, pay_23, pay_29, pay_35)), na.rm = T),
         pref_insurance = rowSums(across(c(insurance_19, insurance_25, insurance_31, insurance_37)), na.rm = T),
         pref_taxes = rowSums(across(c(taxes_21, taxes_27, taxes_33, taxes_39)), na.rm = T),
         pref = rowMeans(across(c(pref_pay, pref_insurance, pref_taxes)), na.rm = T)) %>% 
  select(id, policy, pun_rew_con, frame, prev_fix_con, pref_pay,
         pref_insurance, pref_taxes, pref, gender, age)
```

\clearpage

# Sample

```{r}
## Collecting descriptives
pct_male = round((sum(e2_clean$gender == 1)/nrow(e2_clean))*100, 2)
pct_female = round((sum(e2_clean$gender == 2)/nrow(e2_clean))*100, 2)
pct_nonbinary = round((sum(e2_clean$gender == 3)/nrow(e2_clean))*100, 2)
mean_age = round(mean(e2_clean$age), 2)
sd_age = round(sd(e2_clean$age), 2)
```


We aimed to recruit 1,000 U.S. MTurk workers via CloudResearch for this study.

Participants from the raw Qualtrics data were only included in this analysis if they completed the survey in its entirety and passed a preregistered attention check, leaving us with `r nrow(e2_clean)` participants (`r pct_female`% female, `r pct_male`% male, `r pct_nonbinary`% nonbinary; Mean~Age~ = `r mean_age`, SD~Age~ = `r sd_age`).

\clearpage

# Means

```{r}
## Collecting means
e2_clean %>% 
  rename(Policy = policy,
         Frame = frame) %>% 
  mutate(Policy = recode(Policy, punishment = "Punishments", reward = "Rewards"),
         Frame = recode(Frame, prevent = "Prevent", fix = "Fix")) %>%
  group_by(Policy, Frame) %>% 
  summarize("Mean Prop. Addressing FNs" = round(mean(pref), 2),
            "Std. Error" = round(std.error(pref), 2),
            "CI - Lower" = round((mean(pref) - (1.96*std.error(pref))), 2),
            "CI - Upper" = round((mean(pref) + (1.96*std.error(pref))), 2),
            "N" = n()) %>% 
  arrange(Policy, desc(Frame)) %>% 
  pander(caption = "Mean Preferences by Policy, Frame (Note that 0 = FP and 1 = FN)",
         split.table = Inf)
```

\clearpage

# Primary Regression Results

Below we conduct an OLS regression of policy (-1 = Punishments; 1 = Rewards), frame (-1 = Prevent; 1 = Fix), and their interaction upon mean preferences (0 = FP; 1 = FN). 

```{r}
## Regression
m1 <- lm(pref ~ prev_fix_con*pun_rew_con, data = e2_clean)
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
## Pretty-printing regression results
stargazer(m1, 
          title = "Primary Regression Results",
          header = FALSE,
          p.auto = TRUE,
          report = ('vc*sp'),
          star.cutoffs = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
          type = "latex",
          font.size = "scriptsize")
```

```{r, results = FALSE}
## Collecting more details on the coefficient of interest
ixn_coef <- fmt_effect_md(m1, "prev_fix_con:pun_rew_con", "beSpi")
ixn_f2 <- round(cohens_f_squared(m1, alternative = "two.sided")[3, 2], 2)
ixn_f2_lower <- round(cohens_f_squared(m1, alternative = "two.sided")[3, 4], 2)
ixn_f2_upper <- round(cohens_f_squared(m1, alternative = "two.sided")[3, 5], 2)
```

We are primarily interested in the interaction, for which we observe the following values: `r ixn_coef`. Additionally, Cohen's $f^2$ for this term (which we will use as a measure of effect size) is `r ixn_f2` (95% CI = [`r ixn_f2_lower`, `r ixn_f2_upper`]).

\clearpage

# Simple Effects

```{r}
## Collecting simple effects and effect sizes
simple_effects <- 
  summary(emtrends(m1, pairwise ~ pun_rew_con, var = "prev_fix_con")$emtrends, infer = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(Policy = case_when(pun_rew_con == -1 ~ "Pun.", pun_rew_con == 1 ~ "Rew."),
         prev_fix_con.trend = round(prev_fix_con.trend, 2),
         SE = round(SE, 2),
         lower.CL = round(lower.CL, 2),
         upper.CL = round(upper.CL, 2),
         t.ratio = round(t.ratio, 2),
         "*d*" = case_when(pun_rew_con == -1 ~ 
                             abs(round(cohens_d(filter(e2_clean, pun_rew_con == -1, prev_fix_con == -1)$pref,
                                                filter(e2_clean, pun_rew_con == -1, prev_fix_con == 1)$pref)[,1], 2)),
                           pun_rew_con == 1 ~
                             abs(round(cohens_d(filter(e2_clean, pun_rew_con == 1, prev_fix_con == -1)$pref,
                                                filter(e2_clean, pun_rew_con == 1, prev_fix_con == 1)$pref)[,1], 2))),
         "*d* - Lower" = case_when(pun_rew_con == -1 ~ 
                                     abs(round(cohens_d(filter(e2_clean, pun_rew_con == -1, prev_fix_con == -1)$pref,
                                                        filter(e2_clean, pun_rew_con == -1, prev_fix_con == 1)$pref)[,3], 2)),
                                   pun_rew_con == 1 ~
                                     abs(round(cohens_d(filter(e2_clean, pun_rew_con == 1, prev_fix_con == -1)$pref,
                                                        filter(e2_clean, pun_rew_con == 1, prev_fix_con == 1)$pref)[,4], 2))),
         "*d* - Upper" = case_when(pun_rew_con == -1 ~ 
                                     abs(round(cohens_d(filter(e2_clean, pun_rew_con == -1, prev_fix_con == -1)$pref,
                                                        filter(e2_clean, pun_rew_con == -1, prev_fix_con == 1)$pref)[,4], 2)),
                                   pun_rew_con == 1 ~
                                     abs(round(cohens_d(filter(e2_clean, pun_rew_con == 1, prev_fix_con == -1)$pref,
                                                        filter(e2_clean, pun_rew_con == 1, prev_fix_con == 1)$pref)[,3], 2)))) %>% 
  select(Policy, prev_fix_con.trend, SE, lower.CL, upper.CL, t.ratio, p.value,
         "*d*", "*d* - Lower", "*d* - Upper") %>% 
  rename("*b*" = prev_fix_con.trend, 
         "95% CI, Lower" = lower.CL,
         "95% CI, Upper" = upper.CL,
         "*t*" = t.ratio,
         "*p*" = p.value)

simple_effects %>% 
  pander(caption = "Simple Effects of Frame at Each Level of Type", 
         split.table = Inf)
```
